_comment: SCCL v3 — NEIGHBORHOOD CERTIFICATION AT ADMISSION. Diagnosis from v2: gold-free forgetting is dominated by loss of GENERALIZATION to unseen instances (arith holdout collapses while trained arith stays retained), and v2's gate-side monitoring (rehearsal + probes + math-RRV) cuts forgetting but at a plasticity cost (over-conservative gate: 12 accept / 8 rollback, math under-trained). v3 tests the admission hypothesis: filter instance-narrow solutions BEFORE they train (a point-cert may train only if it is also consistent on a self-generated spec variant), targeting generalization damage at the source instead of vetoing it at the gate after the fact. Ladder (all seeded, torch_seed=42 — compare WITHIN this run): frozen (control) < sccl (v1 point-cert ref) < sccl_n (v1 + neighborhood admission, THE NEW MECHANISM) < sccl_promote (v2 monitoring + probe curriculum ref) < vsr_nogold (gold-test reference). sccl_n is deliberately v1 + ONLY the admission filter (no replay/probe) to isolate the mechanism. Fully gold-free: the variant check is spec-only (paraphrase for code / numeric variant + majority vote for math); gold is final-eval + telemetry only. Same stream/hash as sccl_main & sccl_v2 (554ce43f182b).
